📖 RHETORICAL AUDIT TAXONOMY

Our auditing engine decomposes text against six core categories of deceptive prose:

  • 🚨 Pure Fiction: Claims presented as indisputable reality without verifiable empirical evidence or concrete data.
  • 🦡 Weasel Words: Evasive qualifiers like "experts agree", "some say", "growing consensus", or passive voice created to avoid accountability.
  • 🧐 Source: Trust Me Bro: Bold statistical assertions or historic breakthroughs with zero citations or methodology.
  • ⚡ Buzzword Overdose: High-syllable jargon density intended to intimidate readers into submission without conveying substance.
  • 🦘 Logical Leap: Non-sequiturs and causality confusion (e.g. "we drink coffee, therefore revenue will 10x").
  • 🕯️ Corporate Gaslighting: Wrapping painful realities (layoffs, price gouging, broken promises) in faux-empathy or triumph.
